name: Table
overview: The biblical concept of the table encompasses both physical and symbolic meanings, notably illustrated in the giving of the two stone tables of testimony to Moses on Mount Sinai, engraved by the finger of God as a divine law and covenant (Exodus 24:12; 31:18). These tables, which were broken and then replaced by a second set (Exodus 32:15; 34:1), represent God's commandments and His covenant relationship with His people, emphasizing the seriousness of obedience and the grace of restoration. The tables also serve as a tangible reminder of God's presence and revelation, as seen in Moses' radiant face after communing with God while holding them (Exodus 34:29).
